title: Summer Nights | KEY.co
description_expanded: Adventure and relaxation are always within reach with a six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes included, making it easy to explore nearby beaches, shops, and local dining. Inside, generous living areas and well-appointed bedrooms provide plenty of space for everyone to unwind after a day along the coast. With beautiful outdoor spaces, modern comforts, and a prime location near the shoreline, this home creates the ideal backdrop for a carefree and memorable beach escape. Just a short stroll from the beach, this spacious coastal retreat offers the perfect setting for memorable gatherings with family and friends. Designed for comfort and connection, the home features bright living spaces, multiple private bedroom suites, and thoughtful amenities throughout. A private pool invites relaxing afternoons in the sun, while the expansive rooftop deck provides breathtaking Gulf views and a front-row seat to unforgettable sunsets over the water.
